name: Dennis J. McNamara
office: Pasadena Unified School District, Board of Education, District No. 7

items.text: Dennis J. McNamara is a retired finance executive and Chartered Financial Analyst. He chairs Pasadena Unified’s Citizens’ Oversight Committee for its $1.4 billion school bond program and has volunteered as a math tutor at Washington Elementary School. He proposes making academic progress a mandatory topic at every board meeting and supports a full audit of the central office. He wants a budget process that begins with classroom needs. He says school closures should come only after a master plan that accounts for enrollment, curriculum, and bond funds. He supports coordinated emergency plans with city and county agencies.
